about: Salinity of irrigated land per region (SPEC §3.4). Fill shares_pct from a published land-reclamation report, or — when the source gives no shares per class — set dominant_class as the team's regional estimate; always cite the source in `source`. Leave values null when unknown: the app then shows 'Salinity unknown — get a soil test'. Never enter a value without a source. A farmer's soil test (EC, dS/m) always overrides these values.

regions.source: FAO (1997). Irrigation in the countries of the former Soviet Union in figures. FAO Water Report 15, Uzbekistan profile (https://www.fao.org/4/w6240e/w6240e20.htm): in 1994, in the upper reaches of the Syr Darya and Amu Darya, less than 10 % of the land was saline or highly saline. Dominant class "slight" is the team's regional estimate.

FAO (1997). Irrigation in the countries of the former Soviet Union in figures. FAO Water Report 15, Uzbekistan profile (https://www.fao.org/4/w6240e/w6240e20.htm): in 1994, downstream (especially in Karakalpakstan) about 95 % of the land was saline, highly saline or very highly saline. Dominant class "moderate" is the team's regional estimate.
